name: Anish Athalye
biography: Anish is a PhD student at MIT working on systems, security, and formal verification. He is currently interested in making hardware wallets more secure. In his free time, he enjoys bending neural networks to his will: among other exploits, he has mastered the art of transfiguration (as far as computers are concerned), exemplified by turning a turtle into a rifle. Twitter: @anishathalye Websites: anish.io (academic), anishathalye.com(blog)
